definitions.full: H7320. Rowmamtiy 'Ezer עֶ֫זֶר רֹמַ֫מְתִּי as proper name, masculine ( I have made lofty help ; compare גִּדַּלְתִּי and references); — son of Heman 1Chr 25:4 , ׳ר ע֑זֶר 25:3 . רֶ֫מֶת see רָאׅמׅוֺת 1.c. above
